name: The Courses at Watters Creek – Traditions
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (3239, the Traditions course); its pars match OpenStreetMap's hole tags (par 72). Men's ratings; Red has only the women's. The WCSGA tee (no rating) is left out.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course: nothing here; watterscreek/trim.py drops the short course, practice holes, range and practice greens.
